options.name: chassis
options.description: List of chassis attributes. All writable attributes supported by BSN REST API with - replaced with _. Some examples are - chassis_user_friendly_name - chassis name in string - telnet_timeout - shell_timeout is the corresponding REST name. Displays Bash timeout value in minutes. Setting this to 0 disables bash timeout.

options.name: throttle
options.description: Throttling delay in seconds. Enables second retry on first failure.

options.name: timeout
options.description: REST timeout in seconds for operations that take longer than FOS default value.

options.name: vfid
options.description: VFID of the switch. Use -1 for FOS without VF enabled or AG.
